notes:
Inbound signup from product team (signup form) -> flagged 'support automation' use case. Initial qual call 2026-02-23 with PM (Asha) + eng lead (Tom). Wants quick self-serve evaluation first, but will escalate to procurement if POC looks good. Key ask: clear guidance on model selection (Llama vs Mistral vs Qwen) given constrained budget.

Highlights from calls and threads:
- "We need something that gives accurate responses on our internal KB but costs under $X/1M tokens, otherwise ops cost kills the business case." (Asha)
- Latency target: end-to-end token streaming for chat: 100-300ms initial token latency, tail under 800ms at typical traffic.
- Throughput: expected 50-120 concurrent chat users during peak; typical daily tokens ~100k-200k during POC.
- Quality vs cost tradeoffs: prefers Mistral variants for cost/perf but worried about hallucination on small-context KB Qs; curious about Llama-2-13B and 70B tradeoffs and Qwen-7B behavior.
- Context: KB size ~500k short docs (FAQs, articles), will run vector search + rerank then full prompt. Interested in embeddings later but initial POC is retrieval+generation.
- Asked about quantized model options (INT8/4) and whether Redwood hosted API offers quantized endpoints or only full precision. Wants to understand inference delta (latency + tokens/sec) for q4 vs fp16 for each model family.
- Routing fallback: asking if Redwood can route to cheaper model variant on heavy load and preserve API compatibility (same response schema) — interested in automatic fallback to smaller model if latency SLO threatened.
- Security: requires SSO/SAML and audit logs; SOC2 is non-negotiable for procurement. Also asked about data retention controls and deletion endpoints.
- Billing: needs example cost model: cost per 1M tokens for Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B-instruct, Qwen-7B-instruct; and example cost projection for 2-week POC (100k tokens/day).

POC proposal discussed (agreed verbally):
- 2-week self-serve POC on hosted_api; Redwood to provide sample latency/cost matrix and recommended model config.
- A/B plan: compare Mistral-7B(instruct) vs Llama-2-13B vs Qwen-7B on 50 golden prompts + 200 random KB queries; measure correctness, hallucination rate, response time, and cost per response.
- Acceptance criteria: >=85% relevance on golden set, mean first-token latency < 350ms for typical prompt, cost < $X/week (TBD after Redwood pricing sample).

Notes on "ask" from AE/SE perspective:
- Provide concise one-pager: model selection guidance matrix (quality vs cost vs latency) for top open model variants Redwood supports. Include recommended default model for support-chat and recommended fallback mapping.
- Provide exact pricing lines for hosted_api (q4/INT8 if supported, otherwise fp16) and example invoice projection for 14-day POC.
- Push SOC2 artifact and short security FAQ for hosted customers.
